companies.name: Sunregen
companies.asset: SBC003 (tripentadecanoin) · retinitis pigmentosa, non-gene-specific · oral small molecule
companies.raise: Raising now · last closed CHF 1.33M placement, Dec 2024
companies.overview: SunRegen Healthcare AG, based in Allschwil near Basel, is developing SBC003, an oral small molecule for retinitis pigmentosa that is not gene-specific. Patents are granted in Japan and China.

notes.text: Senju asset review. To confirm: size and terms of the current raise; runway to Phase 1; IND route (Swiss filing Jul 2025, FDA, or both); non-gene-specific data across RP genotypes; Japan patent scope and Japan rights appetite.

companies.name: SeaBeLife
companies.asset: SBL03 · dry AMD / geographic atrophy · topical gel, small-molecule necroptosis and ferroptosis inhibitor
companies.raise: Raising Series A now · last €2M pre-Series A, Oct 2025 (iXLife)
companies.overview: SeaBeLife SAS, in Roscoff, is developing SBL03, a small molecule that blocks two cell-death pathways, as a topical gel for dry AMD and geographic atrophy. It is raising a Series A ahead of a first clinical trial planned for 2026.

notes.text: Senju asset review. To confirm: Series A size, timing and lead; runway; first-in-human timing and country; role of the intravitreal formulation; fit with Senju's topical franchise and Japan rights.

companies.name: Authera
companies.asset: AuT-1 · NPDR, DME, wet AMD and RVO explored · intravitreal antibody-based biologic
companies.raise: Research Council of Norway grant, Nov 2025 · amount not stated
companies.overview: Authera AS, in Oslo, is developing AuT-1, an antibody-based biologic from an FcRn-engineering platform, as an intravitreal treatment. It is exploring NPDR, DME, wet AMD and RVO and plans a first clinical study in 2028.

notes.text: Senju asset review. Runway 12+ months (per notes). To confirm: which indication leads; grant amount and timing of the next equity raise; where FcRn-engineered biologics fit Senju's pipeline; Japan or APAC rights interest.

companies.name: D-Sight
companies.asset: Topical ocular sitagliptin · early DR / NPDR; glaucoma preclinical · neuroprotective eye drop
companies.raise: ~€2M public and private, Feb 2026, led by Clave Capital · ~€5M total invested
companies.overview: D-Sight, a Vall d'Hebron spin-off in Barcelona, is developing a neuroprotective sitagliptin eye drop for early diabetic retinopathy, with glaucoma in preclinical work. Its Phase 1 in healthy volunteers is due to complete in 2026.

notes.text: Senju asset review. Runway 12+ months (per notes). To confirm: Phase 1 readout timing; Phase 2 design, size and geography; Series A size and timing; glaucoma programme timeline; Japan or APAC rights interest.

companies.name: Vantage
companies.asset: Oruvestat (VX-01) · moderate to severe NPDR · oral selective AOC3 inhibitor
companies.seeking: Prefers a pharma partner or acquirer (per notes)
companies.timing: Phase 3 to start before Phase 2 topline (per notes)
companies.overview: Vantage Biosciences, in London, is developing oruvestat, an oral AOC3 inhibitor for moderate to severe NPDR. Its Phase 2 SeeClear study completed enrolment in August 2026 across 26 sites in the US, Australia and South-East Asia, with topline due Q4 2027.

notes.text: Senju asset review. Runway 12+ months (per notes). To confirm: Phase 3 start date, size and geography; whether Japan is in the Phase 3 footprint; last raise amount and date; licence or acquisition preferred; Japan or APAC rights interest.

sources: Vantage Biosciences release via BioSpace, 4 Aug 2026

companies.name: Ageless Bio
companies.asset: UNR844 (lipoic acid choline ester) · presbyopia · small-molecule antioxidant eye drop, acquired from Novartis
companies.overview: Ageless Bio, in Brussels, holds global rights to UNR844, a presbyopia eye drop acquired from Novartis after Novartis discontinued it in 2022 following Phase 2. It is reformulating the drop and raising capital.

notes.text: Senju asset review. Novartis Phase 2 included Japanese sites. To confirm: why Novartis stopped and what the new formulation fixes; access to Novartis Phase 2 data, including Japan; raise size and runway; reformulation timeline to the next clinical study; Japan or APAC rights interest.
